Planetary Annihilation is this games spiritual successor. If you can pick it up for $5 I recommend it. It's fun but it's not balanced or competitive but building a deathstar and launching planets at each other is fun.

There's no unit limit either, so if you like unit spamming this can be fun.

Maybe it's not competitive in the same style as SC for example, but it can result in some great matches though. Yeah it still needs balance but it's really improved over time and strategies can get pretty deep when both players are good. Spamming won't work though, if you know your unit matchups you can easily melt a huge army coming your way.

I've found the game to be pretty competitive despite a small playerbase, the mindgames and strategies on spherical maps can get quite deep.
